title: cyperus unioloides var. bromoides
intro: Cyperus unioloides var. bromoides, commonly known as the East Indian sedge, is a type of plant species within the genus Cyperus. It is a medicinal plant used in traditional medicine, particularly in India, where it is valued for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and fever, as well as being used to treat various gastrointestinal issues. The therapeutic actions of East Indian sedge include anti-inflammatory, antipyretic, and antidiarrheal properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins. The bioactive constituents in East Indian sedge may also possess antimicrobial and antioxidant activities, although further research is needed to confirm these effects.
